# sherpa-app-shell

The frame for an app and its Contexts. Nav and header are PRE-COMPOSED; slotting your own replaces the default.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | App Shell |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-app-shell/sherpa-app-shell.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-app-shell/sherpa-app-shell.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-app-shell/sherpa-app-shell.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-app-shell/sherpa-app-shell.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-app-shell/sherpa-app-shell.example.json) |

## When to use it

The frame for an app: the nav, the app header, the Context, and a panel area on each side for a fixed panel, such as filters. Settings goes in its `overlay` slot as a `<sherpa-dialog data-type="overlay">`; a quick peek over the Context is a `sherpa-overlay-panel`, not a panel area.

## Example

```html
<div style="block-size: 480px"><sherpa-app-shell><sherpa-nav slot="nav" data-current-id="home"></sherpa-nav><sherpa-app-header slot="header" data-heading="Home"></sherpa-app-header><p>The page.</p></sherpa-app-shell></div>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-nav`:

```json
{
  "product": {
    "name": "Sherpa"
  },
  "sections": [
    {
      "label": "Main",
      "items": [
        {
          "id": "home",
          "label": "Home",
          "icon": "home",
          "href": "?context=home"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-nav-state` | `collapsed` `hover` `default` `pinned` `settings` | `collapsed` | collapsed \| hover \| default \| pinned \| settings — mirrored from the rail; drives the content inset |
| `data-no-header` | boolean | `false` | let the content span the full height (no header row) |
| `data-no-nav` | boolean | `false` | drop the nav rail; the content spans the full width |
| `data-no-room` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-panel-end-open` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-panel-end-width` | text |  | a panel area's width, in px — what a reader dragged it to, handed back by the host. The area never goes under its min or over 33% of its row. |
| `data-panel-start-open` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-panel-start-width` | text |  | a panel area's width, in px — what a reader dragged it to, handed back by the host. The area never goes under its min or over 33% of its row. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `panel-area-resize` | `{ side: 'end' \| 'start'; width: number }` | An area's inner edge was dragged, or moved by the keys. |
| `panel-room-change` | `{ room: boolean }` | The body gained or lost room for a panel area. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `nav` | nav | replace the default &lt;[sherpa-nav](sherpa-nav.md)> |
| `header` | header, toolbar | replace the default &lt;[sherpa-app-header](sherpa-app-header.md)> |
| `panel-start` | panel |  |
| (default) | content | the Context content |
| `panel-end` | panel |  |
| `overlay` | dialog |  |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`body`, `content`, `frame`, `header`, `nav`, `overlay`, `panel-end`, `panel-end-edge`, `panel-start`, `panel-start-edge`

## populate()

`{ navState?, noHeader?, noNav?, noRoom?, panelEndOpen?, panelEndWidth?, panelStartOpen?, panelStartWidth? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
